hero.subtitle: Less admin, more beauty. Your team calendar, clients, reminders and AI setup — in one calm workspace for your salon.
hero.note: 14-day free trial · made for beauty businesses in Vietnam

dive.title: Step inside.
dive.body: Stylists at work, clients in the chair, the phone buzzing at reception. This is where GuGu Studio lives.

before.title: Zalo chats, a paper notebook and a lot of guessing.
before.body: Bookings come in from every direction. Someone writes them down — or forgets. Two clients turn up for the same slot. Others never show.
before.chat: Hi, can I come at 3pm tomorrow?

calendar.title: The whole team on one screen.
calendar.body: Every stylist, every break and every appointment for today. Availability is checked for you, so no more double bookings.

clients.title: Every client, remembered.
clients.body: Upcoming visits, services, prices and status at a glance, with each client's history building up as they come back.

reminders.title: Confirmations and reminders go out by themselves.
reminders.body: Clients get a confirmation and a reminder by Zalo or email before their visit, so fewer chairs stay empty.
reminders.msg: Hi Thu Trang! See you tomorrow at 15:00 for gel nails with Mai at GuGu Demo Salon. Reply to change your time.

ai.title: Snap your price list. Done.
ai.body: Upload photos of your price list and AI builds your service menu for you to check. Included in every plan.
ai.list:
Gel nails ........ 200k
Nail art ........ 150k
Hair cut ........ 120k
Facial ........... 300k

insights.title: Know how your salon is doing.
insights.body: Bookings, new clients, occupancy and estimated revenue — updated as your day goes.

assistant.title: Too busy to look? Just ask.
assistant.body: The assistant answers from your salon's own calendar and drafts the message for you.
assistant.q: Any free slot for gel nails tomorrow afternoon with Mai?
assistant.a: Mai is free tomorrow at 14:00 and 16:30 (gel nails, 60 min). Want me to draft a message?
assistant.privacy: Works on your salon's own data. No customer personal data is sent to the AI model.

finale.title: From a Zalo message to a confirmed booking.
finale.body: A client asks on Zalo. You check real availability in GuGu Studio, send a ready-made message with free slots, and book it in the calendar. The client gets a confirmation and a reminder automatically.
finale.ask: Hi! Can I book gel nails tomorrow afternoon?
finale.offer: Hi! Tomorrow we have 14:00 or 16:30 with Mai (gel nails, 60 min). Which one suits you?
finale.confirm: Booked: gel nails with Mai, tomorrow 16:30. We'll remind you the day before.
